listing.name: SSX Tricky / OpenTricky (GiZcesi)
listing.summary: Explore SSX Tricky / OpenTricky (GiZcesi) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Let the upstream launcher finish setup
steps.instruction: Extract the complete official unstable Windows x64 ZIP into a new empty folder. On first deliberate launch of OpenTricky.exe, choose your own USA original-Xbox SSX Tricky ISO or XISO. PS2, GameCube, PAL and Japanese editions are not supported by this route. Windows 10/11 x64 and Direct3D 11 are required. The package has no installer.

steps.title: Keep the launcher as the update owner
steps.instruction: Choose OpenTricky.exe with its folder as the working directory when registering it, then save launch details and choose Play separately. The launcher controls game settings, original-disc selection and consented signature-checked updates. Portcove leaves the external runtime under that owner; discovery never starts the updater. The documented Linux/Steam Deck route uses Wine/Proton with the Windows package; it is not a separate native Linux archive.

steps.title: Preserve saves when changing versions
steps.instruction: Back up Documents/My Games/SSX Tricky/Saves, or the local Saves directory and portable.txt if you chose portable saves. Keep settings.ini, screenshots and bug reports separately as needed. For 0.1.2 use the launcher’s updater. From 0.1.1 upstream requires a fresh folder, choosing the disc again and fresh settings; keep the old working copy and do not copy its settings.ini over 0.1.3. New launch shortcuts use bin/SSX Tricky.exe. External registration provides no Portcove-managed Update, Backup or Rollback.
